t: Bendon Publishing - Wikipedia
s: February 5, 2025 - Bendon is an American publisher of children's books. In 2007, Kappa Books acquired a minority stake in Bendon. In 2012, The Wicks Group purchased the majority stake in Bendon. In 2013, Bendon had acquired Dalmatian Press. In 2014, Bendon acquired Artistic Studios.
